description: He wears a long dark navy-blue textured coat over a cream long tunic, with pale geometric woven borders along the coat opening, hem and cuffs. A modest brown fur collar frames the neck, and two round metal clasps are joined across the chest. A matching blue patterned woven sash is belted at the waist with one tasseled end hanging in front. Dark patterned trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the ensemble. The visible fabrics resemble wool and linen, though their exact fiber content cannot be established from the image. The outfit fully covers torso and limbs, and has no headgear, weapons or armor.
